params.caption: 🎮 Laid-off id Software devs launch their own shooter studio Around 20 former id Software developers, let go in Microsoft's mass layoffs, have co-founded Hidden Horses, a new employee-owned studio focused on shooters. The team plans a Kickstarter campaign to help fund its first game. 🕒 Nov 11, 2026 · 23:09 (GMT+3) 📰 Source: PC Gamer 🔥 React if you'd back their Kickstarter · 💬 What shooter should they make? #idSoftware #HiddenHorses #GamingNews
